name: Gold Medal Products Co. - Indianapolis
old_description: At Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you’ll find customer service is the number one priority. Since 1993, we have served as the region’s concession equipment and supplies provider. Our customers range from Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart. Our local reps know and understand your market. We keep our showroom and warehouse fully stocked with all the popcorn, cotton candy, Sno-Kone®, hot dog, fryer, and other concession equipment you need. We’ll provide an in-house demo so you can see and taste the products in action. When you buy from Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you get more than just a product. You get personalized service, local support, savings on shipping, and many other benefits.
about:
Gold Medal Products Co. – Indianapolis has operated from Noblesville, Indiana since 1993, when it began as the region’s dedicated concession equipment and supplies provider. The branch is managed by Michael Knotts and serves a territory stretching from Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart.

The company maintains a fully stocked showroom and warehouse offering popcorn machines, cotton candy equipment, Sno‑Kone® systems, hot dog rollers, fryers, and related concession supplies. Customers can schedule in‑house demonstrations to see and taste products before purchasing, and the team provides expert consultation for new menu items or start‑up concession operations.

Its customer base includes independent concession operators, venue managers, and food‑service businesses across central Indiana and surrounding areas. Typical buyers range from movie theaters and sports arenas to fairgrounds and seasonal stands looking for equipment and bulk supplies.

The branch differentiates itself through personalized service, local market knowledge, and shipping cost savings for regional customers. The company states that customer service is its top priority, emphasizing hands‑on support and rapid access to inventory.
